skills.name: search-apartments
skills.description: Search Landing furnished apartments by city and dates. Supports fixed-length and Flex (open-ended) stays.

skills.name: check-availability
skills.description: Check whether a Landing home is available for the requested dates and surface the price quote. Available on home detail pages (PDP) only.

skills.name: get-flex-options-web
skills.description: List the flex commitment tiers the home currently being viewed accepts (filtered by the home's minimum nightly stay). Available on home detail pages (PDP) only.

skills.name: list-markets-mcp
skills.description: List the Landing markets currently accepting bookings (one row per market).

skills.name: get-market-filters-mcp
skills.description: Returns all available filter options for a given market — bedroom counts, amenities, price range, bathroom options, neighborhoods, and sort orders.

skills.name: search-apartments-mcp
skills.description: Search Landing's published furnished apartments in a given market.

skills.name: search-apartments-on-map-mcp
skills.description: Search Landing's published furnished apartments in a given market and render the results as an interactive map (pins), not a card grid.

skills.name: get-apartment-mcp
skills.description: Fetch a single Landing home by its slug — property details, amenities, photos, **flex pricing**, **the full availability calendar**, and a pre-filled `reservation_link` so the agent doesn't have to probe dates or assemble booking URLs by hand (get_apartment already returns the full calendar).

skills.name: get-flex-options-mcp
skills.description: Return the flex (open-ended) commitment tiers a given home accepts, so the agent doesn't suggest a `committed_nights` value the home will reject.

skills.name: get-quote-mcp
skills.description: Real, date-specific anonymous quote for a home. Mirrors what an unauthenticated visitor sees in checkout: monthly rent after seasonal adjustments and length-of-stay discounts, the first-month charge, ongoing monthly cost, and an estimated total.

skills.name: booking-intent-mcp
skills.description: Save the guest's interest in a home so Landing can follow up, then return a direct checkout link for them to complete the booking.

skills.name: compare-apartments-mcp
skills.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-4 Landing homes — price, size, amenities, ratings, and availability in one call, instead of stitching together multiple get_home calls yourself.

skills.name: get-market-info-mcp
skills.description: Market context for a Landing market: average monthly rent by bedroom count, total published inventory, and the neighborhoods with the most availability — useful for cross-market comparisons ("is Austin or Dallas cheaper for a 1BR?") without paging through search_apartments.

skills.name: get-policies-faq-mcp
skills.description: Grounded, conservative answers to the most common Landing policy questions (deposits, pets, parking, cancellation, qualification, LandingFlex, utilities, move-in). Use this instead of guessing at policy specifics — where an exact number (deposit amount, cancellation window) depends on the home/market/reservation, the answer says so explicitly and points to get_quote, checkout, or Landing support rather than inventing a figure.

skills.name: list-markets-http
skills.description: List the Landing markets currently accepting bookings (one row per market). Plain HTTP GET — no auth. Use this if you can't reach or speak MCP.
